esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; TF-Luna LiDAR distance sensor needs at least 3.7 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TXD/SCL → RX2 (the board's RX), RXD/SDA → TX2 (the board's TX). Added the tfluna.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the distance, signal strength and chip temperature set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; TF-Luna LiDAR distance sensor needs at least 3.7 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TXD/SCL → GP1 (the board's RX), RXD/SDA → GP0 (the board's TX). Added the tfluna.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the distance, signal strength and chip temperature set on the sliders: passes
